title: Item:Blessed Blood Offering
wikitext:
[[Image:QuestItem_BlessedBloodOffering.png]]

One of three key flagging items to advance [[Against the Demon Queen]] quest line. Obtained from [[An Offering of Blood]] quest, can be turned in at any time to [[Zawabi]] the djinn.

The other 2 items to advance the [[Against the Demon Queen]] quest line:
* [[Phylactery of Raiyum]] Obtained from [[The Chamber of Raiyum]]
* [[Orb of the Efreet]]  Obtained from [[Chains of Flame]] 

After bringing all 3 items to [[Zawabi the Elder Djinni]], he will bestow you the pre-raid quest.
